categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt properly configured with sitemap reference
@astrojs/sitemap integration for automatic sitemap generation
Canonical URLs correctly generated for all pages
trailingSlash: 'never' ensures clean, consistent URLs
_redirects file handles sitemap alias (301)
Astro SSG ensures fast static HTML output
SEO-friendly URL structure: /tools/{name}, /guides/{name}, /blog/{slug}
Custom 404 page with helpful navigation links

findings.title: Site Not Deployed
findings.description: foodintolerancecheck.com currently returns a parked page (114 bytes) that redirects to /lander via JavaScript. No actual site content is served.
findings.recommendation: Deploy the Astro build to a hosting provider (Cloudflare Pages, Netlify, Vercel, etc.) and verify DNS configuration.

findings.title: Missing Security Headers
findings.description: No Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, or Strict-Transport-Security headers configured.
findings.recommendation: Add security headers via hosting provider configuration or _headers file.

findings.title: 10 Meta Descriptions Outside Optimal Range
findings.description: About (162 chars), blog/elimination-diet-guide (163), guides/ibs-food-intolerance (161), guides/intolerance-vs-allergy (162), guides/test-guide (163), symptoms (164), tools (178), tools/food-diary (164) all exceed 160 chars. /terms (113) is below 120 chars.
findings.recommendation: Trim descriptions to ≤160 characters. Expand /terms description to ≥120 characters.

findings.title: IBS Guide Title Tag Too Long
findings.description: /guides/ibs-food-intolerance title is 65 characters, potentially truncated in SERPs.
findings.recommendation: Shorten to 'IBS & Food Intolerance - Management Guide - FoodCheck' (55 chars).

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Strong E-E-A-T signals: named author (Dr. Emily Carter, Registered Dietitian) on all articles and guides
References to authoritative sources (NHS, BDA, NICE, AAAAI, Monash, EAACI)
Clear medical disclaimers on every page including tools
Detailed About page with editorial standards, methodology, and author bio
Evidence-based content with blockquote citations from peer-reviewed sources
Good content hierarchy with question-based H2 headings matching search intent
Comprehensive guide coverage: 5 guides + 3 blog posts + 6 tools + symptoms + FAQ

findings.title: FAQ Page H1 Missing Primary Keyword
findings.description: /faq H1 is 'Frequently Asked Questions' — does not include 'Food Intolerance' keyword. This page targets 'food intolerance faq' but the H1 lacks the primary term.
findings.recommendation: Change H1 to 'Food Intolerance FAQ' to align with target keyword.

findings.title: Contact Email Missing Across Site
findings.description: Neither the About page, Footer, nor Privacy page include a direct email address. Privacy page links to 'our About page' for contact. This slightly weakens E-E-A-T trust signals.
findings.recommendation: Add hello@foodintolerancecheck.com to the About page and Footer.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: All 24 pages have unique, keyword-rich title tags
All pages have meta descriptions with relevant keywords
Single H1 per page with clear hierarchy (H1 > H2 > H3)
Question-based H2 headings that match search intent
Strong internal linking between related pages
Breadcrumb navigation on 22 of 24 pages
Descriptive anchor text for internal links
Excellent tool page content with data, statistics, and citations

findings.title: Privacy and Terms Pages Missing Breadcrumbs
findings.description: /privacy and /terms pages do not pass breadcrumbs prop to BaseLayout, so they lack both visible breadcrumbs and BreadcrumbList schema.
findings.recommendation: Add breadcrumbs={[{ label: 'Privacy Policy', href: '/privacy' }]} and similar for /terms.

findings.title: HowTo Schema Step URLs Don't Match HTML
findings.description: /blog/elimination-diet-guide has HowTo schema with step[].url pointing to #step-1 through #step-4 fragments, but no H2 headings have corresponding id attributes.
findings.recommendation: Add id='step-1' through id='step-4' to the corresponding H2 headings in the guide.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Organization schema on homepage with SearchAction
WebApplication schema on all 6 tool pages with HealthApplication category
Article schema with author, publisher, dates on all blog/guide posts
MedicalWebPage schema on all medical content pages
FAQPage schema on homepage AND /faq page
AboutPage + Person schema on /about page
ItemList schema on listing pages (tools, guides, blog)
HowTo schema on elimination diet guide
BreadcrumbList schema on 22 of 24 pages
Website schema with SearchAction potential action

findings.title: Privacy and Terms Pages Missing Schema
findings.description: /privacy and /terms have no schema markup at all. Even a basic WebPage schema would improve structured data coverage.
findings.recommendation: Add WebPage schema to both pages, plus BreadcrumbList schema when breadcrumbs are added.

findings.title: Article Schema Publisher Logo Uses OG Image
findings.description: Article schema publisher logo URL points to /og-default.png (a large OG image, 1200x630px). Schema publisher logos should be small brand logos.
findings.recommendation: Create a dedicated brand logo image (e.g., /logo-square.png) and update the Article schema publisher logo URL in BaseLayout.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Astro SSG produces minimal JavaScript by default
All images use Astro Image component with WebP format and width/height attributes
Hero image uses loading='eager' and fetchpriority='high'
Other images use loading='lazy'
No third-party analytics or tracking scripts
Minimal client-side JavaScript (only checker/diary scripts, max 126 lines)
Tailwind CSS purge eliminates unused styles

findings.title: Cannot Measure Live CWV (Site Not Deployed)
findings.description: Site is not deployed so no real Core Web Vitals data available. Estimated performance based on code analysis suggests excellent metrics.
findings.recommendation: Deploy the site first, then run Lighthouse/PageSpeed Insights to measure actual CWV metrics.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: llms.txt file present with comprehensive site map and content policy
Clear, structured content with question-based headings
Evidence-based citations from authoritative sources (NHS, BDA, NICE, Monash)
Named author with credentials (Dr. Emily Carter, Registered Dietitian)
Medical disclaimers improve AI citation accuracy
Comprehensive llms-full.txt present with expanded per-page summaries

findings.title: No Contact Information for AI Verification
findings.description: AI search engines use contact information as a trust signal. No email address is directly visible on the site (Privacy page links to About page for contact).
findings.recommendation: Add a contact email to the About page and Footer to improve AI citation trust signals.

categories.name: Images
what_works: All images have descriptive, unique alt text
Astro Image component auto-converts to WebP format
Width (800) and height (450) attributes set for all images
Proper loading strategy: eager for hero, lazy for rest
No duplicate images (public/images/ removed)
All images unique per page — no more image reuse

findings.title: No PNG Favicon
findings.description: Only favicon.svg is provided. Some platforms prefer PNG/ICO for favicons.
findings.recommendation: Add a 32x32 and 16x16 PNG favicon alongside the SVG.
